title: Latest learning update and admin APK published
summary: Published the latest Android production update to Expo, verified the signed 1.0.4 build 6 APK, and deployed its download settings to the Lecomax admin panel.

changes.detail: Published current lessons, notebook, learning interface and wellness changes on Expo production runtime 1.0.4; update group b7576e28-153d-4341-b979-b0a8d618332f.
Built signed Android APK 1.0.4 code 6, Expo build 900ab341-2229-4f8e-9bb6-bc96a669d01b, retaining package com.lecomax.learning and existing signing certificate.

Updated production LEARNING_ANDROID_APK_URL to the verified Expo artifact and LEARNING_ANDROID_VERSION to 1.0.4 (build 6). Redeployed existing production source as dpl_GgP5J53zyaZQ2xyiHfFHt3ZW1pra; lecomax.com and www.lecomax.com point to the ready deployment.
Appended this linked verification report while preserving all previous history records.

validation.name: Source checks

validation.name: APK integrity and update configuration
validation.detail: Verified package/version, existing release signer, backup disabled, Expo updates enabled with ALWAYS launch checks, production channel and expected project URL. APK SHA256 da487100453b6e793a43fe67ddfffc0b81bdde89419acf71bbe50d0488c221d3. Release report exists in bundle.

validation.name: Source and APK secret audit
validation.detail: Source and exported bundle audits passed. Scanned all 1320 APK ZIP entries against 11 configured backend secrets with no findings.

validation.name: Admin rendering and production deployment
validation.detail: Component rendering verified new download link, build 6 label and preservation instructions. Vercel reported deployment ready and assigned live domains. Live homepage 200; unauthenticated admin page redirected 307; sessions and invalid login returned expected 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS.
